mostWorthwhile.text: Making the dark potato bay was most worthwhile: the result explained why tubers need shade while shoots need light.

leastWorthwhile.text: Planting the soybeans was clear but felt less connected to the listed goals, since it did not advance either one.

surprise.text: The plain fabric became a wick that draws solution upward without another pump; its purpose was not clear beforehand.

arbitrary.text: The foil-and-fabric combination initially felt like a guess, but fitting it to the bed explained its purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the crop-specific details made the short, menu-guided actions physically understandable, even if the choices involved little compatibility discovery.
